programs.title: How It's Made 20
programs.sub_title: Stagecoaches, traffic lights, motorcycle fuel tanks, fired ceramics
programs.desc: Every day, modern people are surrounded by objects that they are so used to that they don't seem to notice.The creators of the series reveal the behind-the-scenes of the production of such things as cowboy boots, buses, ballet shoes, sinks and trumpets.They visit factories in various places around the world and follow the often very complicated production process - from obtaining raw materials to the final product.The episodes of the new series will explain, among others:how tissues, orange liqueur, belt buckles and croissants are made.

programs.desc: The Internet is full of videos of home-grown scientists presenting their achievements.Scientists and experts will take a look at these incredible achievements and then choose the best among them.Viewers will see private backyards and garages where these amazing inventions are created.A review from a precise drone catcher that turns into a train powered by pressure, to a home-made tank that becomes a hot air balloon.Viewers will also see giant knives thrown from cranes, aiming at refrigerators full of explosives, and parachuting from a drone.
